column1: How the Bachelder map was tied to modern coordinates

Four places that are on the 1876 map and still stand were matched to their modern coordinates. A best-fit shift, turn and uniform scale (no stretching) was computed from them and applied to every pixel position read off the scan.
Fit: 1.232 m per pixel, map turned 0.98 degrees from true north. Pixel positions are in the full-resolution scan (7,814 x 9,310).
